row.name: Heartflow Inc. Common Stock

checks.label: not up two days in a row
checks.threshold: up_run <= 1, counting days above +1.0%; veto at 3+ up closes of any size

checks.label: linearity of the prior leg
checks.threshold: ER >= 0.4 or R2 >= 0.55 (both for A+); failing is a veto

checks.label: young trend: first or second breakout
checks.threshold: prior breakouts since the move started <= 1 (0 for A+)
checks.note: today would be breakout 8 of this move

checks.label: narrow or negative day before
checks.threshold: prior day negative or range < 2.0% (A+: negative and under its 20-session median range)

checks.label: consolidation quality
checks.display: base_sessions=5 breakdowns=0 bursts_in_base=0 giveback=0.23 tightness=0.8 base_volume_vs_leg=0.99 base_volume_vs_avg=1.11
checks.threshold: base 3-20 sessions, breakdowns <= 1, giveback <= 0.34, tightness <= 1.0 (A+: 0 breakdowns, 0 bursts inside, giveback <= 0.25, tightness <= 0.7, base volume under the leg's and the 50-session average)

checks.label: close near the high
checks.threshold: close_pos >= 0.8 and close > open (A+ >= 0.9; partial from 0.7)

checks.label: range expansion
checks.threshold: today's range over the largest of the prior 5 >= 1.0 (A+: also over the prior 10)

checks.label: higher volume
checks.threshold: volume > prior session (A+: rank <= 3 of the last 60); a base over 21 sessions also needs >= 1.5x the 50-session average

notes: extension: close 4.4% vs its 20-SMA, 60.9% over 20 sessions
prior breakouts worked 2 of 4 (closed higher 3 sessions later, last 4 in 60 sessions)

claude.reason: The Y criterion is a hard fail: this is breakout number 8 of a move that has already run 107% in 34 sessions, and the chart confirms it — the shaded base sits near the top of a staircase of repeated breakouts visible across the entire right half of the chart. The consolidation box itself shows several wide, overlapping bars spanning roughly $45–$52, which is not tight relative to the prior leg's volatility. Volume on the burst is barely above the prior session (1.01x), ranking only 11th of the last 60, which is weak confirmation for a name this extended.
claude.key_risk: Eight breakouts into a 107% move means late-trend buyers absorb selling from every prior entry point; a single down day can cascade through all those stops.
claude.entry_note: Skip if the open is below the burst bar's close (~$49.88) or if the first 30 minutes show any fade back into the base range below ~$47.

row.summary: HTFL: +9.7% on 1.0× volume out of a base 12.3% deep. skip 8.5, 5 of 6 criteria.
